cards.ex: I was so tired, I started to nod off during the movie.
cards.exUz: Shunchalik charchagandim, kinoda uxlab qola boshladim.

cards.ex: I usually drift off as soon as my head hits the pillow.
cards.exUz: Odatda boshim yostiqqa tegishi bilan uyquga ketaman.

cards.ex: I slept like a log last night; I didn't hear a thing.
cards.exUz: Kecha kechasi qattiq uxladim; hech narsani eshitmadim.

cards.ex: I couldn't sleep last night; I was tossing and turning all night.
cards.exUz: Kecha kechasi uxlay olmadim; tun bo'yi ag'darilib uxladim.

cards.ex: I need to get some shut-eye before the long drive.
cards.exUz: Uzoq yo'lga chiqishdan oldin biroz uxlab olishim kerak.

cards.ex: Don't make a decision now; sleep on it, and tell me tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Hozir qaror qabul qilmang; o'ylab ko'ring va menga ertaga ayting.
cards.uzDef: Biror qaror qabul qilishdan oldin, bir kecha o'ylab ko'rish.

cards.ex: I had a terrible nightmare last night about falling off a cliff.
cards.exUz: Kecha kechasi qoyadan yiqilib tushish haqida dahshatli tush ko'rdim.

cards.ex: After a full night's sleep, I woke up feeling refreshed.
cards.exUz: To'liq tun uxlashdan keyin, men o'zimni tetik his qilib uyg'ondim.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi dam olgandan keyin tetik va kuchli uyg'onish.

cards.ex: I'm a light sleeper, so even the slightest noise wakes me up.
cards.exUz: Men yengil uxlayman, shuning uchun eng kichik shovqin ham meni uyg'otadi.
cards.uzDef: Har qanday shovqinga tezda uyg'onadigan odam.

cards.ex: My husband is a heavy sleeper; nothing wakes him up.
cards.exUz: Erim qattiq uxlaydi; uni hech narsa uyg'otmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Shovqinlarga sezilmaydigan va qattiq uxlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: It's getting late; I think I'll hit the hay.
cards.exUz: Kech bo'lyapti; menimcha, uxlagani yotaman.

cards.ex: I'm going to try and catch some z's on the train.
cards.exUz: Poyezdda biroz uxlab dam olishga harakat qilmoqchiman.

cards.ex: Even though it's late, I'm wide awake.
cards.exUz: Kech bo'lishiga qaramay, men to'liq uyg'oqman.

cards.ex: He used to have episodes of sleepwalking when he was a child.
cards.exUz: U bolaligida uyquda yurish holatlariga duch kelgan.

cards.ex: I had a lucid dream last night and flew around the world.
cards.exUz: Kecha kechasi ongli tush ko'rdim va dunyo bo'ylab uchib yurdim.
cards.uzDef: Tushingizda ekanligingizni bilib, tushni boshqara olish.

cards.ex: Sleep deprivation can affect your mood and concentration.
cards.exUz: Uyqusizlik sizning kayfiyatingiz va diqqatingizga ta'sir qilishi mumkin.

cards.ex: I overslept this morning and missed my train.
cards.exUz: Men bugun ertalab kech qoldim va poyezdimga ulgurmadim.

cards.ex: I love to sleep in on Sundays.
cards.exUz: Men yakshanba kunlari ertalab uzoqroq uxlashni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Dam olish kuni ertalab uzoqroq uxlash.

cards.ex: I need to catch up on some sleep this weekend.
cards.exUz: Men shu hafta oxirida biroz uyqini to'ldirishim kerak.

cards.ex: I had a restless sleep last night; I kept waking up.
cards.exUz: Kecha kechasi bezovta uxladim; men doimo uyg'onib turdim.

cards.ex: I dozed off in the middle of the meeting.
cards.exUz: Men yig'ilishning o'rtasida uyuqlab qoldim.

cards.ex: Goodnight, sweet dreams!
cards.exUz: Xayrli tun, shirin tushlar!

cards.ex: Wake up, sleepyhead! It's time for breakfast.
cards.exUz: Uyg'on, uyquchi! Nonushta vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Uxlayotgan yoki uxlashni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: The baby is sound asleep in her crib.
cards.exUz: Chaqaloq o'z beshigida qattiq uxlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda chuqur va tinch uyquda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He dreamed up a brilliant plan to save the company.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyani qutqarish uchun ajoyib reja o'ylab topdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi va g'ayrioddiy g'oyani o'ylab topish.

cards.ex: Are you tired? Not by a long shot!
cards.exUz: Siz charchadingizmi? Umuman yo'q!

cards.ex: I had a complete brain fart and forgot her name.
cards.exUz: Menga xotira pand berdi va uning ismini unutdim.

cards.ex: I had to burn the midnight oil to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun kechgacha ishlashga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha yoki tungacha qattiq ishlash yoki o'qish.

cards.ex: I need to get my beauty sleep before the party tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertangi ziyofatdan oldin go'zallik uykusini olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Go'zallik va sog'liq uchun zarur bo'lgan uyqu.

cards.ex: I always hit a wall around 3 PM.
cards.exUz: Men har doim soat 3 larda charchoqni his qilaman.
